roleGate.description: v0.3.7: optional build-capability marker — true only when the running code includes the operator role gate (0008). Absent = pre-W25 build (old core).

rollbackFence.description: v0.3.7: optional build-capability marker — true only when the running code includes the 0009 rollout fence (operator-disable/release). Absent = pre-0009 build.

dbInstanceId.description: v0.3.8: optional org-content digest (auxiliary only as of v0.3.9) — sha256b64 over the ordered org_ulid list. NOT a db-file/instance identity proof: a full-copy db reports the same digest.

codeDigest.description: v0.3.9: optional running-code self-attestation — sha256b64 of the core app.mjs bytes as loaded at process start, emitted from code. Release manifest matching requires manifest == healthz == release CLI tree digest. Absent = pre-v0.3.9 build (rejected by operator-disable-release verification).
